description: This file defines a PHP class 'PimDefinedReportDetailedModel' in the 'OrangeHRM' project. The class models a detailed report for the PIM plugin, including methods for serializing report data into an array with criteria, field groups, and inclusion type. It interacts with report generation and entity classes to retrieve report details and filters.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class representing detailed report data, capable of serializing report info, filters, and display fields into an array.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the ReportGeneratorService instance used by the class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the report object.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Returns the Report entity associated with this model.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the report details, including filters, display fields, and inclusion type, into an associative array.
